title: Return policy page found
question: Can an agent find the return policy?
method: Follow homepage links whose text or URL matches return, refund, Widerruf, retour or similar, or MerchantReturnPolicy.merchantReturnLink. Pass when the page is fetchable and longer than 300 words.

title: Shipping policy page found
question: Can an agent find shipping costs, regions and delivery times?
method: Same link heuristics for shipping, delivery, Versand, livraison. Pass when the page is fetchable and mentions regions, costs or delivery times.

title: Privacy policy and terms found
question: Are the privacy policy and terms of service linked and fetchable?
method: Look for the WordPress privacy page link, link text matching privacy, Datenschutz, terms, AGB, conditions. Pass when both pages are fetchable.

title: Merchant identity
question: Who is selling, where are they, and how can they be reached?
method: Pass when Organization JSON-LD (name, address or contactPoint) exists, or an imprint or about page carries a legal name and address.

title: Contact channel
question: Is there an email address or contact form reachable from the footer?
method: Pass when the homepage footer links to a mailto: address or a page whose URL or link text indicates a contact form.

title: Policy pages are agent-readable
question: Can an agent actually read the policy pages it found?
method: For each policy page found, require server-rendered text (as in A3.2) and no robots.txt or meta robots rule that blocks shopping agents. Skip when no policy page was found.

title: security.txt
question: Does the site publish a security contact?
method: GET /.well-known/security.txt. Pass on a text document with Contact: and Expires: fields whose Expires date is in the future.
